Get status of my husqvarna automowers
## Use this MCP Server

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "husqvarna-automower": {
      "command": "docker",
      "args": [
        "run",
        "-i",
        "--rm",
        "-e",
        "HUSQVARNA_CLIENT_ID",
        "-e",
        "HUSQVARNA_CLIENT_SECRET",
        "mcp/husqvarna-automower"
      ],
      "env": {
        "HUSQVARNA_CLIENT_ID": "YOUR_CLIENT_ID_HERE",
        "HUSQVARNA_CLIENT_SECRET": "YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET_HERE"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
